description: Defines a utility enum GatewayDiscoveryPreferences for managing user preferences related to gateway stable IDs using UserDefaults.

methods.name: preferredStableID
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred stable ID from UserDefaults, with fallback to a legacy key and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: setPreferredStableID
methods.description: Stores or removes the preferred stable ID in UserDefaults, handling whitespace trimming and key cleanup.
